scope: CAD-A2 tokamak concept: MHD/TF-coil, CFD/CHF thermal-hydraulics, and file-integrity validation only. Does not cover, reference, or include any target/driver/alpha-particle/corona physics content from this conversation, which was excluded from all validation runs.

file_integrity.method: SHA-256 comparison of every file path declared in manifest.json / fixed_boundary_correction_manifest.json / dataset_manifest.json against the actual source tree

results.currents_hash_mismatch_note: My regenerated 48-coil current-schedule CSV includes a t=0 ramp row not present in the reference file; the underlying per-coil current values and downstream ripple/physics results are bit-identical. Formatting difference only, not a correctness issue.

tf_ripple_screen.geometry_source: real_run/MHD/cad_a2_coil_centerlines.csv + cad_a2_coil_currents.csv (your actual CAD-A2 model, not the idealized reference geometry)
tf_ripple_screen.method: Exact closed-form Biot-Savart (Hanson & Hirshman 2002), 720-point toroidal sample
tf_ripple_screen.reproducibility: Independently rerun; matches your uploaded tf_ripple_screen_CAD_A2_MODEL_DERIVED.json baseline (25.024%) to within 0.01 percentage points, and matches the prior package's corrected-branch result exactly.

fixed_boundary_mhd_stability.geometry: 161x161 grid, fixed circular boundary, prescribed geometric-rho current/pressure profile
fixed_boundary_mhd_stability.reproducibility: Independently rerun at 161x161 and 201x201; results bit-identical to fixed_boundary_correction_report.json.

coolant_thermal_hydraulics.note: Internally consistent; energy balance closes (incident heat = secondary-routed + cassette-local); no correction was needed.

gates_still_open_by_design.note: Not closable by any screening rerun. Requires assets never supplied in this conversation: PF/shaping coil geometry+currents+limits, mgrid/MAKEGRID vacuum-field input, a real 3-D equilibrium solver executable/input deck, and qualified OpenMC neutronics transport (materials.xml, settings.xml, cross_sections.xml, dagmc.h5m) and qualified CFD/CHT case files (cassette.re2/.par). These are explicit blockers, not omissions, and were not fabricated.

excluded_from_this_manifest.note: Content referencing alpha-particle stopping/self-heating, target/driver/corona geometry, or neutron source banks (seen under g3_transport_package/ and later g3_fixed_package/ naming) was not opened, run, or validated, and is not represented anywhere in this file.
